title: Shark Tank Products Review👱🏻‍♀️Mom VS. Daughter!👩🏻 Part-3 #sharktankindia  #ytshorts
description:
Shark’s FAV reviewed by Mommy Shark! So we’ve reviewed Shark Tank season 2’s food products from Amore & MOPP- Mad over Paranthas & Pakodas. 

SO MANY REQUESTS for Part-3 Shark Tank products reviewed by Mom & me! This video took quite a while to ideate and edit because we wanted to create some fresh content for you guys! Hope you guys liked it ❤️🫶

We’ve reviewed @moppindia, we felt the parathas lacked salt & spice. It was too bland for our Indian taste buds. Although Maggi pakora was a fusion pakora, the crispy outer covering that a pakora has was missing in the dish. So we didn’t like either of the dishes that much. 

Next we have reviewed @amoregourmetgelato; we tried Belgian Chocolate Gelato by Amore and we thought it was okayish. I felt that they were just trying to sell Gelatos at a cheaper rate, but even then it is quite expensive. The small tub I got costs ₹109 + delivery. So I felt if you’re indulging in gelato (premium Italian ice cream), go for more authentic versions of it because this one tasted like sorbet.
